name: Greenskies Clean Energy LLC
old_description: Greenskies helps businesses use solar to reduce electricity costs, strengthen long-term energy strategy, and support sustainability goals.
about:
Greenskies Clean Energy LLC is a commercial solar developer, owner, and operator headquartered in North Haven, Connecticut. Founded in 2009, the company has originated, developed, constructed, financed, owned, and operated solar projects across the United States.

The firm provides integrated services spanning the full solar project lifecycle — from early evaluation and project structuring through financing, engineering, construction, asset management, and long-term operations. To date, Greenskies has developed and constructed more than 400 MW of solar capacity across 745-plus projects in 19 states, covering rooftops, parking canopies, open land, landfills, brownfields, community solar, and small utility installations.

Its customer base includes corporate energy buyers, commercial real estate owners and REITs, municipalities, school districts, higher education institutions, public agencies, utilities, and solar developers and EPC partners. Notable projects include a 295 kW rooftop system for Adelphi University and a capped landfill installation for the town of New Haven, CT.

Greenskies distinguishes itself through a single-team model that retains accountability from development through operations, a long-term ownership approach that aligns incentives with project performance, and national experience navigating diverse utility territories and site conditions.

name: Greentech Renewables Virginia
old_description: Build better energy systems and gain a competitive advantage with Greentech Renewables Richmond, VA
about:
Greentech Renewables Virginia operates from a facility in Richmond, Virginia. The location is part of Greentech Renewables, a national network of solar equipment distributors. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The branch functions as a wholesale distributor of solar photovoltaic equipment and related components. It maintains an extensive on-site inventory available for will-call pickup and offers daily delivery service to contractors across the region. The staff provides technical support ranging from initial system design through commissioning, acting as a local resource for product expertise and sales assistance.

Primary customers are solar installation companies and EPC contractors serving residential and commercial markets. A featured project shows the Richmond location supplied equipment for a 14.56 kW ground-mount residential system in Maurertown, Virginia, installed by Mid-Atlantic Solar Solutions. The distributor serves the broader Mid-Atlantic region from its Richmond base.

Greentech Renewables positions itself as a service-oriented distributor, emphasizing knowledgeable staff, local inventory depth, and rapid fulfillment through daily deliveries. The company highlights its ability to support installers from design to commissioning as a key differentiator in the solar supply chain.

name: Grimm Metal Fabricators Inc
old_description: Grimm Metal Fabricators, Inc. is a full service fabricating and welding facility.
about:
Grimm Metal Fabricators, Inc. operates from Lombard, Illinois, where it runs a full-service fabricating and welding facility across two adjacent buildings totaling 42,000 square feet. The company describes itself as a job shop capable of handling projects ranging from small parts to large weldments.

The shop offers a range of metalworking processes including forming, rolling, plasma cutting, saw cutting, shearing, punching, and basic machining. Equipment includes two press brakes capable of forming up to 14 feet by 500 tons, four plate rolls (the largest CNC unit rolling 1-inch plate at 10 feet), two CNC high-definition plasma tables handling parts up to 10 by 24 feet, a CNC band saw with auto-feed, a 12-foot shear with NC back gauge, a 26-station CNC turret punch, two lathes, milling machines, a CNC machining center with 20 by 40 inches of travel, and four overhead cranes providing 10 tons of lifting capacity per bay.

The company does not specify target industries in its public materials, positioning itself as a general job shop serving a broad variety of fabrication needs.

Grimm Metal Fabricators emphasizes its ability to handle diverse project sizes and its investment in modern welding and cutting equipment as key differentiators.

name: Grinnell Cabinet Makers
old_description: Grinnell Cabinet Makers work with the world’s best architects, builders, decorators, and designers to take your space to the next level.
about:
Grinnell Cabinet Makers has operated from Cranston, Rhode Island since 1979. The company was founded to provide custom millwork services and has built a reputation for quality crafted millwork produced in its own shops.

The firm specializes in custom architectural millwork for banks, restaurants, and commercial interiors. Its capabilities span teller lines, security glazing, customer service stations, platform desks, office walls, back-room cabinetry, check desks, ATM surrounds, bars, hostess stations, custom casework, trim, mouldings, custom window and door units, pre-fabricated wall paneling systems, hotel furnishings, high-end commercial displays, hardwood doors, and pre-fabricated office partitions. The company works with wood, high-end laminates, and metals, and handles projects from Maine to Florida and across the country.

Grinnell serves architects, builders, decorators, and designers, as well as direct clients in banking, hospitality, and commercial real estate. Notable projects include the East Boston Savings Bank Chinatown Branch, Abe and Louie's in Boston's Back Bay, Bank RI in Providence, and restaurant interiors such as Reel House, Oyster Club, and Orfano's. The company coordinates with client schedules to avoid business disruption.

Grinnell emphasizes a dual focus on constructed quality and exceptional service, employing top craftsmen to ensure that millwork produced in its shops results in the finest finishes. The company was started to deliver unsurpassed quality and service in a product-oriented industry.

name: Gryffon Ridge Spice Merchants ~ Women Owned, Based in Maine
old_description: Specializing in Organic Offerings and Hand Crafted Culinary Blends.
about:
Gryffon Ridge Spice Merchants operates from Litchfield, Maine, where it was founded in 2009. The women-owned, privately held corporation began with a single farmers market stand in Brunswick, offering 12 handcrafted blends alongside a modest selection of herbs, spices, and gourmet salts. The owner remains directly involved in daily operations, overseeing production and customer service.

The company produces a range of certified organic herbs, spices, culinary blends, gourmet salts, flavored sugars, and chile powders. All culinary blends are handcrafted in small batches using recipes developed and tested over years, without stabilizers, anti-caking agents, fillers, or artificial ingredients; several blends are salt-free. Products are packaged in solid glass jars for retail, and the firm also fulfills wholesale orders for business customers.

Gryffon Ridge serves both retail consumers and wholesale buyers, including specialty food retailers, grocers, and culinary professionals seeking organic seasoning ingredients. Its products are sold online and through a network of retail locations in New England, with a dedicated wholesale channel for bulk purchases.

The company distinguishes itself as the only certified organic spice company in Maine and one of the highest-quality organic vendors in New England. Its differentiation rests on small-batch craftsmanship, a strict no-additives policy, and direct owner oversight of every production step.

name: Gumbo Medical
old_description: Affordable hospital beds are in high demand. We understand that you are looking for both
about:
Gumbo Medical, LLC is based in Las Vegas, Nevada. The family-owned business was founded in 2001 in New Orleans, Louisiana, before relocating to its current headquarters.

The company operates as both an authorized direct distributor of newly manufactured medical equipment and a direct supplier of refurbished pre-owned devices. Its in-house refurbishment process is performed by trained technicians on a wide range of equipment, including hospital beds, stretchers, infusion pumps, monitors, exam tables, and infant warmers from brands such as Hill-Rom, Stryker, and GE. Gumbo Medical maintains a large inventory of new and refurbished medical furniture and devices, and also offers repair and restoration, replacement parts, leasing and rental options, equipment appraisals, and a buy-back program for used equipment.

Gumbo Medical serves hospitals, surgery centers, clinics, private practices, educational facilities, and schools across the healthcare industry. Its customer base includes institutions seeking affordable, quality medical equipment with warranty-backed support.

The company differentiates itself by performing refurbishment work in-house rather than outsourcing, emphasizing intimate technical product knowledge and an industry-best refurbishment process. It earned a DOTmed Top 100 ranking in 2021 and ships worldwide, providing limited warranty and ongoing customer support on every piece of equipment sold.

name: H & H Sheet Metal Fabricators
old_description: H&H Sheet Metal is an ISO 9001 Certified Sheet Metal facility. We have produced specialized precision produced sheet metal parts and assemblies since 1983.
about:
H & H Sheet Metal Fabricators operates from Russellville, Kentucky, where it was founded in 1983. The company is 100% employee-owned and has grown from a sheet metal facility into a full-service industrial fabricator and installer serving the region for over four decades.

The shop runs a 90-by-325-foot fabrication facility equipped with CNC press brakes, milling machines, and lathes, supported by a workforce of more than 100 employees. In-house engineering and design feed a range of capabilities that include sheet metal and structural metal fabrication, welding and pipe fitting, concrete pouring and finishing, millwright services, and process piping. The company also maintains over one million pounds of raw metal inventory and deploys field-service technicians in fully equipped vehicles, backed by a fleet of man-lifts, forklifts, backhoes, dozers, and cranes.

H & H serves industrial customers across south central Kentucky, the Midwest, and the Southeast, providing fabrication, installation, repair, and maintenance for air-handling, material-handling, piping, process-system, and safety-application projects. Crews can scale from one to eighty tradespeople to match project size.

The company emphasizes its employee-ownership model, ISO 9001 certification, and a reputation for quality workmanship, competitive pricing, and on-time delivery as the foundation of its long-term client relationships.

name: H&H Metals
old_description: Architectural sheet metal fabricator, and manufacturer of aluminum sunshades and light shelves in the Denver area.
about:
H&H Metals was founded in 1991 in Thornton, Colorado, as a custom sheet metal fabrication job shop serving the Denver metropolitan area. The company operates from a facility on Grant Drive and focuses on architectural sheet metal work, including the manufacture of aluminum sunshades and light shelves.

The shop provides laser cutting, bending and forming, shearing and blanking, CNC routing, and welding, supported by a large in-stock inventory of steel, stainless steel, and aluminum sheet, plate, tubing, flat bar, and angle. An internal order tracking system called O.T.I.S. gives customers real-time email updates on project status, and the company offers design services for sunshade clips along with detailed installation drawings, though it does not perform installation itself.

H&H Metals serves the architectural and commercial construction markets, supplying products such as architectural aluminum sunshades, sun control devices, BrightShelf® lightshelves, ornamental and decorative metals, aluminum composite material (ACM) panels, metal wall panels, and insulated spandrel infill panels. Customers include architects, contractors, and building owners seeking custom-fabricated metal components for building envelopes.

The company emphasizes its 35-plus years of experience, domestic manufacturing, and a multi-faceted shop capable of handling diverse customization requests. All products are designed, fabricated, and finished in Denver using domestic materials, and finishes meet AAMA 2604 Superdurable standards.

name: H.W. Woodwork
old_description: HW Woodwork company is a second generation millwork company providing high-end architectural woodwork for the luxury residential market.
about:
H.W. Woodwork is a second-generation millwork company based in Milwaukee, Wisconsin. The business was founded by Hans Werner, who began by providing millwork for residential customers. Ownership remains in the family, though the exact founding year is not publicly disclosed.

The company specializes in high-end architectural woodwork for the luxury residential market. It operates as a full-service manufacturer, handling estimating, engineering, manufacturing, finishing, and installation in-house. Every project is shepherded through each construction phase by an executive of the management team, a structure intended to ensure personal quality oversight and seamless integration.

H.W. Woodwork serves a nationwide clientele that includes property owners, architects, interior designers, and general contractors. All projects are focused on luxury residential work, from custom cabinetry to complex architectural millwork packages.

The firm states that its executive-led project management differentiates it, providing a single point of accountability from estimate to installation. Its stated mission is to deliver the highest level of service and craftsmanship on schedule and at competitive pricing.
